# Section 070: Progressive Delivery With Argo Rollouts

A new version should reach users a step at a time and stop on bad metrics. This section teaches canary and blue/green releases with Argo Rollouts, the primary progressive delivery tool. It covers an automatic gate on a Prometheus metric and traffic shifting through a Gateway API route.

**Curriculum item covered:** Deploying Applications Using Progressive Delivery Strategies (for example Blue/Green or Canary)

---

## What You Will Master

- Convert a Deployment into a Rollout with canary steps (setWeight and pause)
- Follow a canary with kubectl argo rollouts get rollout --watch
- Promote, pause and abort a rollout and name the ReplicaSet that serves traffic
- Explain how Argo Rollouts approximates a weight with replica counts when no traffic router is configured
- Retry an aborted rollout after the image is fixed
- Explain the difference between promote and promote --full
- Replace a pause step with an inline analysis step that uses the web provider against a canary Service
- Start a release with an environment variable and read its AnalysisRun
- Configure a blueGreen strategy with activeService, previewService and autoPromotionEnabled set to false
- Test the new version through the preview Service before promotion
- Write an AnalysisTemplate that queries Prometheus for the success rate of the new version
- Run the analysis as prePromotionAnalysis and read the AnalysisRun result
- Prove that a failing metric aborts the release and keeps the old version active
